stories.title: U.S.-Israeli war with Iran continues as 3 American troops are killed
stories.summary: Three U.S. service members have been killed in ongoing operations in the Middle East, as U.S. and Israeli strikes continue to hit Iran and Iran responds with waves of missiles and drones across the region.

stories.title: Iranian spokesperson says country has 'no other choice' but to fight back
stories.summary: Esmail Baghaei, spokeman for Iran's Foreign Ministry, talks about his country's response to U.S. and Israeli airstrikes.

stories.title: Iranians in Los Angeles react to the strikes on Iran
stories.summary: The Iranian diaspora in Los Angeles has celebrated the Trump administration's strikes against Iran, but some have mixed feelings.

stories.title: Texas Rep. Tony Gonzales faces primary challenge amid allegations of affair
stories.summary: Caught in controversy, Republican Rep. Tony Gonzales faces a tough primary challenge as his voters weigh whether to back him again in Tuesday's primary.

stories.title: How war in Iran could impact global energy markets
stories.summary: The U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, a major oil producer, threatens to impact oil and natural gas markets worldwide.

stories.title: What is the U.S. military's capacity to carry out extended strikes in Iran?
stories.summary: Seth Jones of the center for Strategic and International Studies talks about the U.S military's capacity to carry out extended strikes in Iran, and Iran's ability to retaliate.
